findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_page_trend · Private data: get_content_actions, get_competitor_keywords · Public sink: get_content_actions · Destructive: get_summary, get_competitor_keywords.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_page_trend · Private data: get_content_actions, get_competitor_keywords · Public sink: get_content_actions · Destructive: get_summary, get_competitor_keywords

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
